label: concurrency 3, launcher verified end to end
why: Third attempt, and this time the knob is checked before the launch: tools/check_notebook_names.py fails on a name that is read and never bound, on a TASK_SELECTION key that is never forwarded, and on a build_notebook() keyword the CLI never passes. The two earlier kernels both ran at concurrency 1 (the second one proved it: 12/12 tasks reproduced the serial baseline's outcome exactly, 5/12, so the screen is deterministic per task and any flip under batching is a real effect). Same 12 paired tasks, same seed, concurrency 3.
